subject: Azure Partner Center: account heatmap + seller alignment (Contoso)
messages:
From: Contoso Sales Ops <marketplace@contoso.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Azure Partner Center <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>; Azure Seller East <azure-seller-east@microsoft.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso marketplace listing -> seller mapping

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for jumping on the call yesterday. As promised, I'm sending our initial account heatmap and a short ask to help map Partner Center referrals to the Contoso field sellers. The referral traffic has started but we see several inbound referrals land without clear owner assignments in Partner Center.

Quick summary of the ask:
- Can Redwood provide a recommended owner mapping for the top 150 Contoso accounts in Partner Center?
- We'd like suggested fallback sellers for accounts that are unassigned or match to shared accounts.
- Any integration notes for the Partner Center referral metadata fields we should expect in the webhook payload.

I've attached: Contoso_account_heatmap_v1.xlsx (top accounts, ARR bands, priority) and PC_referral_report-ctso.pdf (sample referral payloads).

Would you, or someone from your field sales ops team, be able to produce a proposed owner-to-account mapping by EOD Tuesday? Contoso's renewal window opens mid-November, so timing is tight.

Thanks — appreciate it.

—Maya Lopez
Sales Operations, Contoso
marketplace@contoso.com

--- attachment: Contoso_account_heatmap_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
--- attachment: PC_referral_report-ctso.pdf (pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Contoso Sales Ops <marketplace@contoso.com>
Cc: Azure Partner Center <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>; Azure Seller East <azure-seller-east@microsoft.com>; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso marketplace listing -> seller mapping

Hi Maya — thanks for the files and the clear ask. Looping in Karthik (partnerships) and Laura from Field Orchestration to produce the heatmap-backed owner mapping.

Plan proposal:
1) Karthik and Laura will reconcile Contoso's top 150 accounts against our seller roster and Partner Center ownership export.
2) We'll surface: primary owner, fallback owner, and a note when accounts look like shared accounts.
3) We'll include a short JSON schema for the referral webhook (fields we rely on).

Request for Clarification:
- Are the ARR bands in tab "Priority" final, or should we use Contoso's CRM as the source of truth?
- Any accounts that must not be reassigned (e.g., legal/regulated)?

We can commit to an internal draft by end of day Tuesday (2026-10-12) and a Contoso-facing spreadsheet by Wednesday morning. If that timeline works I will assign owners.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of SMB Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso marketplace listing -> seller mapping

Vanessa / Laura — starting the reconciliation now. Initial approach and blockers below: 

Approach:
- Pull latest Partner Center ownership export (seller_id, account_id, preference flags) and join against Contoso_account_heatmap_v1.xlsx.
- Use match priority: exact account number -> domain match -> manual review.
- Recommend fallback seller = nearest regional owner with existing relationship in last 12 months.

Blockers / questions:
- The Partner Center export we have lacks the "last_contacted" field; Contoso provided ARR bands but not CRM IDs for a subset of accounts (about 18 rows). Need Contoso to confirm CRM ids for those.
- For shared-ownership accounts we should propose a routing policy: 1) primary owner; 2) PSTZ fallback; 3) Redwood-managed sales support if unknown. Are we OK pushing fallback to PSTZ?

Deliverables
- Internal mapping CSV (with confidence score) by EOD Tuesday 10/12.
- Contoso-facing spreadsheet with owner notes by 10/13 morning.

I'll attach a stub mapping in the drive link and will update as I go.

--- attachment: draft_mapping_stub.csv (csv)
From: Contoso Sales Ops <marketplace@contoso.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Azure Partner Center <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>, Azure Seller East <azure-seller-east@microsoft.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PartnerCenter referral: Contoso marketplace listing -> seller mapping

Thanks Vanessa and team — that timeline works. Quick answers:
- ARR bands on the sheet are final for this exercise. Use those.
- Attached is a short CSV with CRM ids for the 18 missing rows (crm_ids_ctso_missing.csv).
- For shared accounts, Contoso prefers we route to the regional PSTZ fallback first, then to Redwood sales support if PSTZ cannot accept.

Look forward to the mapping. If you need a brief sync, we can do a 20-min call tomorrow at 9am PT.

Best,
Maya Lopez
Sales Operations, Contoso
